integrity: The proof uses the source's necessary-and-sufficient descent criterion and exact canonical-loop pairings. Two tabulated knots provide coefficient-separating witnesses. The bundled program only replays the resulting finite-dimensional linear algebra; it is not used to infer an infinite statement from samples.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies descent only in the three-generator integral span and the four-generator mod-2 span of the named knot-space 1-cocycles. It does not compute the full first cohomology of the parametrized or unparametrized closed-knot spaces and does not prove the source's low-order basis conjecture.
title: Exact descent filtration in the Zhang cocycle span
